import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
other_count = len(df) - breed_counts.sum()

# Create a new series with 'Other' category
breed_counts = pd.concat([breed_counts, pd.Series({'Other': other_count})])

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.barplot(x=breed_counts.values, y=breed_counts.index, palette='viridis')
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs')
plt.ylabel('Breed')
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich (and Other Category)')
plt.grid(axis='x', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
other_count = len(df) - breed_counts.sum()

# Create a new series with 'Other' category
breed_counts = pd.concat([breed_counts, pd.Series({'Other': other_count})])

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.barplot(x=breed_counts.values, y=breed_counts.index, palette='viridis')
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs')
plt.ylabel('Breed')
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich (and Other Category)')

plt.tight_layout()
